Question: Barney Schwinn notices that the odometer on his bicycle reads \(1441,\) a palindrome, because it reads the same forward and backward. After riding \(4\) more hours that day and \(6\) the next, he notices that the odometer shows another palindrome, \(1661.\) What was his average speed in miles per hour?
Solution:
The increase in the odometer gives the distance traveled:
\[
1661-1441=220\text{ miles}.
\]
Barney rode for \(4+6=10\) hours altogether. Average speed is total distance divided by total riding time, so his average speed was
\[
\frac{220}{10}=\boxed{22}\text{ miles per hour},
\]
choice \(\text{E}\).
